page19._doc: Region-level catalogue of 'no detectable inversion' calls — complement of the page3 positive catalogue. Each region carries a region_status field (e.g. no_detectable_inversion_high_confidence) — NOT a binary positive/negative; the static caution banner explicitly warns against that misreading. Loaded from negative_regions.json or .tsv via #nrLoadBtn / #nrLoadInput; summary cards (#nrSummaryCards) show per-region_status counts; full per-region detail in #nrTableSlot. Export-CSV via #nrExportCsvBtn; reset via #nrResetBtn. The complement framing is deliberate: 'no detectable inversion' means no signal above the study's resolution / sample size / callability limits — tiny inversions, very rare inversions (1-2 fish), inversions in repetitive or low-callability regions, and inversions whose breakpoints fall outside short-read mappability can all be missed. page11._doc: Boundaries refinement page. Refines a promoted candidate's [start_bp, end_bp] into approximate left/right boundary zones using multiple evidence tracks. Save (B) persists the boundary annotation onto the candidate; Reset (R) clears. Terminology contract: `boundary_zone` is the default verdict (what auto ever produces); `exact_breakpoint` is reserved for junction-level evidence only. Scan radius is selectable across nine fixed steps (1 kb / 5 kb / 10 kb / 25 kb / 100 kb / 1 Mb / 1.5 Mb / 2 Mb / 5 Mb) — the smaller four match the MODULE_3 win5000.step1000 and win10000.step2000 θπ scales; the upper four kick in automatically beyond CANDIDATE_HUGE_BP via `_boundaryScanRange`. page_sv_evidence._doc: Read-only candidate-level view of SV calls clustered around a candidate's boundaries, scored against the karyotype groups. Loads json/sv_genotype_counts/<cid>.json per candidate (the renderer reads state.candidate.id and fetches that file). Renders three things stacked top-to-bottom: SV table (caller, type, chrom, pos, len, support, gt-counts), UpSet plot of caller intersections, and a dosage heatmap (step-6 spec). DOM contract: #page_sv_evidence (page wrapper) + #sv_evidence_root (single inner mount slot owned by AtlasSVEvidence). page_sv_evidence is a thin loader stub: the renderer is window.AtlasSVEvidence (an OBJECT with .init / .loadCandidate / .destroy methods, distinct from page6's + page7's single-function renderers), defined externally in js/atlas_sv_evidence.js (NOT inlined in legacy Inversion_atlas.html). page_sv_evidence.js's showSvEvidencePage(state) tries window.AtlasSVEvidence and falls back to a missing-module empty-state message in #sv_evidence_root (guarded by .__svInitFailed) if absent. On the present path init() is guarded by mod.__pageInitDone (called once) and loadCandidate(cid) is guarded by mod.__lastCid (re-fired only when the active candidate id changes). hideSvEvidencePage() calls mod.destroy() if available. page10._doc: Diagnostic PCR marker panel cards for each candidate inversion regime. Reproduces the genome-based regime call (g0/g1/g2 from fish_regime_calls.tsv) using 3-10 markers per candidate. Activates when marker_panel_summary is present in state.data._layers_present; renders empty state with drag-in instructions otherwise. Emits one card per panel summary entry: candidate id + coords, regime counts, tier badge (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW colored), expected accuracy, n markers, panel class, per-regime marker counts (g0/g1/g2 diagnostic), Tm range + multiplex spread (≤4°C = safe, otherwise tight), warning tags, and (when marker_catalogue + marker_primers layers also loaded) a per-marker table with marker_id, position, variant_type, target_regime, specificity_score, freq_g0/g1/g2, family_spread_score, amplicon size, Tm forward/reverse. Final block: textual interpretation (which markers support which regime + combined-panel accuracy on the calibration cohort). Source: legacy/Inversion_atlas.html lines 57837-58043 (verbatim helper _markerPanelCardHtml + renderMarkerPage). See SCHEMA §10 for column contracts.
